title: Well-posedness of the heat equation in domains with topological transitions
summary: We analyze a linear parabolic equation with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions posed in domains whose evolution may involve topological transitions. The domains are described as sublevel sets of a smooth space-time level set function, allowing for transitions such as domain splitting and merging and the creation or vanishing of islands and holes.
